title: FLA import: custom ease Bezier curve not decoded from CPicPage afterData
description: FLA binary stores motionEase as a signed integer (-100..100) for the classic ease dial but the custom ease curve (Bezier control points in a CPicPage afterData block) is never decoded. Frame.easeCurve is always null for imported FLAs, flattening any custom ease to integer approximation. Decode the CPicPage ease curve block referenced in flacomdoc.
